title: Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces Rental Period Values: Breaks in Need, Coverage Changes and Hospice
content:
Four Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces values govern whether a bed rental stays in one rental period: the days of a break in need, beyond the days left in the rental month it began, after which a new rental period starts; what a new rental period after a long break needs; what the rental needs when a new primary coverage starts paying; and whether coverage billing stops from the hospice election date because the hospice furnishes the bed.

| Bed class | Break-in-need days | A new rental period after a long break needs | When a new primary coverage starts paying, the rental needs | Coverage billing stops from the hospice election date |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fixed-Height Hospital Bed (E0250) | 60 days | a new order | a new order | Yes |
| Variable-Height Hospital Bed (E0255) | 60 days | a new order | a new order | Yes |
| Semi-Electric Hospital Bed (E0260) | 60 days | a new order | a new order | Yes |
| Total Electric Hospital Bed (E0265) | 60 days | a new order | a new order | Yes |
| Heavy-Duty Hospital Bed (E0303) | 60 days | a new order | a new order | Yes |
| Extra Heavy-Duty Hospital Bed (E0304) | 60 days | a new order | a new order | Yes |

## Reference notes

- **Break-in-need days.** The value is 60 days in every class. It is defined as the days of a break in need, beyond the days left in the rental month in which the break began, after which a new rental period starts.
- **Long break.** In every class, what a new rental period after a long break needs is a new order.
- **New primary coverage.** In every class, what the rental needs when a new primary coverage starts paying is a new order.
- **Hospice.** Every class carries Yes: coverage billing stops from the hospice election date because the hospice furnishes the bed.

### The values in question-and-answer form

**Does any bed class use a break-in-need figure other than 60 days?** No. All six classes carry 60 days.

**Is the requirement after a long break different from the requirement when a new primary coverage starts paying?** No. Both values read "a new order" for every class.

**Is there a class for which coverage billing continues past the hospice election date?** No. The value is Yes for all six classes.
